sections.title: A perspective shaped by experience
paragraphs: Ying-Ting Wang is an associate professor and Chair of Yuan Ze University’s Department of Social and Policy Sciences. She is also listed in the IBSC faculty directory.
Her expertise centers on social demography and health inequality. She earned a doctorate in Sociology, with a specialization in demography, at the University of Texas at Austin.

Her listed research examines family structures, living arrangements, intergenerational relationships, and their connections with health and well-being. Her work considers these questions in Taiwan and other social contexts.
